traditional: A soft contact. Love, money, and pleasure supports growth, fortune, and patronage - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas. Two benefics: among the easiest contacts, though it can incline to excess.
modern: Pleasure meets expansion. Gentleness, generosity, sensitivity, and a great deal of ease. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Warmth, goodwill, and good fortune in what you value. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize connection and growth into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what connection and growth have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
shadow: The ease lets indulgence and vanity and excess and overreach go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.summary: A generous offer may reach the right person just as a smaller plan needs room to grow.
readerCopy.body: A generous offer may reach the right person just as a smaller plan needs room to grow. Venus sextile Jupiter can bring an introduction, extra budget, invitation, or public endorsement that opens a larger social or financial door without requiring the whole project to change direction. Use the help on the part that was actually stuck. Secure the space, make the hire, place the order, or follow the introduction while the offer is active. A good opportunity becomes useful when the added support has a specific job.
